🎭 March 2026: Spring Arts, Food & Culture

🌊 Things to Do in Destin Florida in March 2026

March is one of the best-kept secrets on the Emerald Coast — warm enough to enjoy the beach, cool enough to explore comfortably, and packed with events. Here's what's happening in Destin in March 2026:

  • 🎭 Northwest Florida Ballet — March 7–8 (family-friendly, Destin area)
  • 💃 Dirty Dancing Live — March 10, Mattie Kelly Arts Center
  • 🧀 Mac & Cheese Festival — March 15, Destin Commons (~$10)
  • 🌍 International Festival — March 21, Fort Walton Beach (FREE)
  • 🛒 Farmers Market — Every Saturday at Grand Blvd & Baytowne Wharf (FREE)
  • 🏖️ Spring Break beach time — Pelican Beach Resort has direct Gulf access
  • 🐬 Dolphin tours & water activities — season kicks off in March. See our water activities guide

March weather in Destin: 65–72°F, low humidity, minimal crowds. See our full Destin weather guide →

8th Annual Mac & Cheese Festival — March 15

Local chefs push the limits with lobster mac, truffle mac, BBQ pulled pork mac, and even dessert mac. Kids eat for less, and there are activities beyond food tasting. ~$10 entry at Destin Commons.

7th Annual International Festival — March 21 🌍 FREE

A vibrant celebration of culture and community in downtown Fort Walton Beach with representation from over 60 nations. International entertainment, cultural performances, global cuisine, artisan vendors, and educational exhibits — all free and open to the public from 11am–7pm. A genuinely special event that flies under the radar.

Northwest Florida Ballet: Alice in Wonderland — March 7–8

An enchanting production perfect for families introducing kids to ballet. Neoclassical dance meets surreal storytelling with immersive set design and original costumes.

Mattie Kelly Arts Center: Dirty Dancing — March 10

The iconic love story comes to life on stage. Perfect date night. This touring production sells out fast — buy tickets early at mkat.org.

🎸 April 2026: Perfect Weather, Incredible Events

Fly Into Spring Kite Festival — April 4–5 ⭐ FREE

One of the most Instagram-worthy events of the year. Giant kites soar over Fort Walton Beach — professional kite flyers, kids' workshops, free admission, and a beachfront location that's perfect for photos. Arrive early for parking.

Also April 4: Big Kahuna's Water & Adventure Park opens for the season — now featuring a brand new wave pool and nighttime laser show for 2026.

🔥 Don't Miss — New for 2026

Joe Bonamassa's Sound Wave Beach Weekend — April 10–12

The blues-rock event of the year. Joe Bonamassa's first-ever curated land festival takes over Miramar Beach (just minutes from Pelican Beach Resort) with an all-star lineup: Gov't Mule, Kenny Wayne Shepherd, Grace Potter, Larkin Poe, Samantha Fish, JJ Grey & Mofro, Little Feat, and more. A 5,500-person open-air venue walking distance from the beach, with exclusive artist jams and premium "Coves" with food & drink service.

Get Tickets & Info →

Food Truck Festival — April 17–19

Three days of mobile culinary excellence — gourmet tacos, artisan pizza, Asian fusion, creative desserts. One of the best casual weekends in Destin for foodies of all ages.

CARE on the Coast TurtleFest — April 18 FREE

Live turtle encounters, beach clean-ups, kids' educational programs, and conservation booths. Free admission. Great for families who want entertainment with purpose.

Rock by the Sea — April 29

Live music at Al's Beach Club — one of Destin's most beloved outdoor music venues right on the Gulf. Check Bandsintown for the full lineup closer to date.

April is the best month to visit Destin. 🌊

Sound Wave Weekend + Kite Festival + Free Concerts + TurtleFest — all in one week. Units go fast.

Check April Availability →

🎵 Weekly & Recurring Events — Don't Miss These

Farmers Markets — Every Saturday, Year-Round FREE

Fresh produce, local honey, artisan crafts, and breakfast vendors at Grand Boulevard and Baytowne Wharf. The perfect way to start a beach day.

MKAF Concerts in the Village — Thursday Evenings, April–May FREE

World-class music under the stars at Baytowne Wharf. Bring chairs and blankets — this is one of the best free events in all of Florida:

  • Apr 9: Smash Mouth
  • Apr 16: Black Jacket Symphony
  • Apr 23: Yacht Rock Revue
  • Apr 30: Rumours (Fleetwood Mac tribute)
  • May 7: Brass Transit (Chicago tribute)

🦀 May 2026: Summer Season Kicks Off

Fudpucker's GatorFest — May 2

Uniquely Florida — live gator demonstrations, kids' activities, food specials, and entertainment at Fudpucker's Beachside Bar & Grill. Perfect for families wanting that authentic Florida experience.

Boogie Wonder Band — May 21

Live at the Mattie Kelly Arts Foundation. Great way to kick off a summer evening on the Emerald Coast.

Memorial Weekend — May 23–25

Destin fills up fast over Memorial Weekend — one of the busiest beach weekends of the year. Book early. The Bob Hope Memorial Charity Golf Tournament (May 14–16) and the 40th Anniversary Gate to Gate Memorial Weekend (May 16) also take place this month.

🎣 June 2026: Fishing Season Peaks

Emerald Coast Blue Marlin Classic — June 17–21 ⭐

Northwest Florida's premier offshore fishing tournament. The world's top anglers converge at Sandestin Marina to compete for massive prize pools targeting Blue Marlin, Wahoo, Tuna, and Mahi. Free to watch the weigh-ins — an incredible spectacle even if you're not fishing.

Summer on the Harbor — June through August

The HarborWalk Village comes alive all summer with free outdoor concerts, weekly fireworks shows, live entertainment, and nightly dining along the water. The Destin Chamber's Great American Picnic on July 14 is a local favorite.

🎆 Weekly All Summer Long

Destin has fireworks 4 nights a week all summer — plus America's 250th Birthday on July 4th, 2026.

🦞 October 2026: The Crown Jewel of Destin

October in Destin is a phenomenon. The crowds thin out, the weather is perfect, the Gulf is still warm — and the entire city transforms for fishing season. If you've never experienced Destin in October, this is the year.

⭐ THE #1 EVENT IN DESTIN

Destin Seafood Festival — First Weekend of October FREE

This is the do-not-miss event of the year. Since 1978, the Destin Seafood Festival has stretched nearly two miles along the Harbor Boardwalk from HarborWalk Village to Heron Harbor — 100+ food and craft vendors, local chefs serving the freshest Gulf catches, live music, ice-cold drinks, and a front-row seat to Destin's legendary fishing fleet. Free admission. Truly unforgettable.

Learn More →

Destin Fishing Rodeo — All of October ⭐ FREE to Watch

Since 1948, the Destin Fishing Rodeo has run the entire month of October — the oldest, biggest, and best fishing tournament in the Southeast. Daily weigh-ins at AJ's on the boardwalk from 10am–7pm draw massive crowds. Watch anglers haul in massive Grouper, Marlin, Wahoo, and even 200lb+ Sharks. Special events every weekend including kids' pier fishing days, a Halloween costume party, and a 5K run.

October highlights: Oct 1 — First Fish of the Rodeo · Every Sat — Biggest Shark competition · Oct 3 — Rodeo 5K Run · Oct 18 — Kids Pier Fishing Day · Oct 31 — Rodeo Halloween Party · Nov 1 — Awards Ceremony at AJ's

Moon Crush Odies Beach Vacation — October 1

Beach music festival at Seascape Resort — the perfect way to kick off Rodeo month.

Fitz and the Tantrums — October 3

The indie pop heavyweights play Seascape Resort. Check Bandsintown for tickets.

October in Destin is magical. 🎣

Seafood Festival + Fishing Rodeo all month + perfect weather + smaller crowds. Book early — it sells out.

Check October Availability →

14th Annual Bourbon at the Bay — November 19

Adults-only premium bourbon tasting event at HarborWalk Village. Tickets required. Perfect couples' getaway weekend.

📱 Frequently Asked Questions

What's the biggest event in Destin in 2026?

The Destin Seafood Festival (early October) is arguably the most beloved annual event — free admission, 100+ vendors along the Harbor Boardwalk, and the energy of Fishing Rodeo month all around it. For music fans, Joe Bonamassa's Sound Wave Beach Weekend (April 10–12) is the most exciting new event of 2026.

Are Destin festivals free?

Many of the best ones are! Free events include the Kite Festival (Apr 4–5), TurtleFest (Apr 18), Thursday night concerts (Apr–May), Farmers Markets every Saturday, Seafood Festival (early Oct), and Fishing Rodeo weigh-ins (all of October). Food and drinks are extra, but admission is free.

When should I book for festival weekends?

Book 2–3 months in advance for popular weekends. Sound Wave Beach Weekend (Apr 10–12), Seafood Festival (early Oct), and Fishing Rodeo month fill up fast. Your 10% discount is automatically applied when you book direct at destincondogetaways.com — no code needed. Chat with Destiny Blue for an extra surprise on top. 🤫

What's the weather like during festival season?

March–May is ideal — 65–80°F, low humidity, sunny. Perfect for outdoor festivals. Pack a light layer for cooler evenings in March. October is equally spectacular — 70–78°F days with cool evenings and warm Gulf water still in the low 70s.

Is Destin a good destination in 2026?

Absolutely — Fodor's Travel named Destin to their prestigious "Go List 2026" as one of the world's top destinations this year. With pristine beaches, record-breaking events, and the new Sound Wave Beach Weekend joining the already packed calendar, 2026 is shaping up to be the best year yet on the Emerald Coast.
